videos.title: First launch
videos.description: A brand-new Converse opens with App Support asking which provider should lead: Meta Muse, OpenAI Codex or Anthropic Claude. Pick one, sign in with that provider's own login in Terminal and the browser, and Converse is ready with App Support's greeting and starter sessions: a coding session, an agent and a Parking Lot.

videos.title: Converse in action
videos.description: A complete walkthrough: first launch, coding with Parking Lots, a real project, making a video, assessments and portraits, and the team that builds Converse. The development diagram is a November 6, 2026 snapshot.

videos.title: Hello World
videos.description: Build a small Python program, edit its plan in a Parking Lot, approve a session’s proposed change, and ask it to update and run the program.

videos.title: A real project
videos.description: Explore Converse’s own Parking Lot and ask a session to assess which bugs to tackle next.

videos.title: Building a video
videos.description: Use a Parking Lot as a script and a session as the video editor. Ask another agent for its portrait and add that material to the script.

videos.title: Assessments and portraits
videos.description: Open assessments and portraits, expand the Steward’s cards, and inspect the separate measurement and art-direction settings in Agent Setup.

videos.title: How Converse builds Converse
videos.description: Follow the people, coding sessions, agents, Parking Lots, devices and Jolly connection that take Converse from an idea through review and release.
